NBA DFS Picks for Wednesday, November 4 (DraftKings)

DraftKings main slate · Wednesday, November 4 · 11 games · First game 7:00 PM ET · By Chris Spags · · Numbers as of November 3, 3:31 PM ET

Cade Cunningham (DET) is the top-projected player on the Wednesday, November 4 DraftKings main slate at 46.1 DraftKings points for $9,300. Shai Gilgeous-Alexander (OKC, 42.8, $10,300) and Alperen Sengun (HOU, 40.5, $8,900) are next.

Michael Porter Jr. (BKN) returns the most per dollar among players projected for at least 20 points: 5.22 projected points per $1,000 at $7,300.

Every projection is a SPAGS model estimate from the November 3, 3:31 PM ET run of the Splash Play NBA model. This page updates each time the main-slate numbers are run, and NBA projections move with every injury report, so check the time above before you build.

How to use these numbers

A projection is a starting point. Salary decides who fits: the Pts/$1K column shows what each player returns for his price. A late scratch changes the minutes and shots of everyone around him, so the numbers from an earlier run can be out of date by the first game.
